review_source: Root's independent read-only review of the exact FC03 diff

findings.cause: Writer catches collapsed original exceptions to trace_write_unavailable; require_written then wrote a generic fallback event without original class/cause/errno/frames.
findings.change: Catch boundaries now call independent append_failure_event with the caught exception and safe operation identity. Journal records exception class/cause, numeric errno when present, and basename/line/function frames without exception message. DiagnosticWriteResult.failure_journal_attempted prevents require_written from duplicating a generic-only event, including when the journal attempt itself is unavailable.
findings.check: py_compile diagnostic_trace.py exit 0; source inspection confirms catch passes error and require_written honors failure_journal_attempted.

findings.cause: DB/store replay exceptions only incremented a counter and discarded their error details.
findings.change: The catch now appends a separate correlated failure_journal_replay_failed event with original job/launch/run/incident/invocation/stage/attempt/correlation, parent operation, failed event ref, exception class/cause/errno/frames, and capture location. No exception message is stored.
findings.check: py_compile failure_journal.py exit 0; source inspection confirms store catch binds exc and calls append_failure_event.

findings.cause: Selecting MAX(observed_at) alone can select a begin at the same millisecond as a later end and falsely classify it open.
findings.change: Latest event selection now compares observed_at and then SQLite rowid as stable append-order tie breaker. The method docstring and AT-TRACE/dictionary/operations log document the ordering. Migration 014 and Store preserve optional numeric exception_errno.
findings.check: py_compile store.py exit 0; in-memory SQLite migration smoke confirms exception_errno column and both immutable triggers; source inspection confirms rowid tie comparison.
findings.runtime_fault_injection: NOT_RUN; timestamp-tie/restart case is FC07 FCT10

build_followup.first_result: FAIL exit 1: writeFlowAssets at tools/docs/inago-requirements/task-flows.mjs:74 failed on open of docs/specifications/inago/図解/F12.svg; Node errno -4094, code UNKNOWN, syscall open. Stack: writeFile -> writeFlowAssets -> build.mjs:11.
build_followup.triage: F12.svg existed (14,202 bytes); file and directory ACLs allowed Modify. The error was not EACCES/permission denied. Node had already parsed/imported task-flows.mjs and reached writeFlowAssets, so malformed JavaScript was not the reported failure. No process lock was proven from this error output.
build_followup.corrective_retry: Same builder command retried once after FC04 paused writes to shared F12/requirements files; exit 0, HTML v2.50, 28 chapters, 39 figures, 26 references, 4,066,177 bytes.
build_followup.result: Requirement source docs and generated HTML/F12 are synchronized for this follow-up.

scope.workflow_provider.py: not modified (FC04 shared-file pause condition honored)
